name: Benin

nso.name: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD; formerly INSAE)

latest_census.notes: RGPH-4, May 2013, is the latest count I know of; a fifth census (RGPH-5) has been planned since 2022 but I am not aware that it has been fielded and published. RGPH-4 asked religion and ethnic group (as did RGPH-3 2002 and RGPH-2 1992) and INSAE published both by département in its synthesis and thematic volumes. Whether RGPH-4 asked a language item I cannot recall (2002 asked language spoken); null. Note the office was renamed from INSAE to INStaD around 2020-2021, so older documents sit under insae-bj.org.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH-4 2013 - 'Synthèse des principaux résultats' and the thematic volume on socio-cultural characteristics (religion, ethnie) by département
subnational_sources.evidence: INSAE's RGPH-4 publications (2015-2016) include religion and ethnic-group distributions for the 12 départements; commune-level (77) versions may exist in the thematic tome but I cannot confirm. Older host insae-bj.org; current instad.bj.

subnational_sources.title: IPUMS-International - Benin 1979, 1992, 2002, 2013 census samples (religion, ethnicity; département and commune geography)
subnational_sources.evidence: Benin's four censuses are all in IPUMS-I with religion and ethnicity variables; 10% samples support commune-level shares for most of the 77 communes.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH-3 2002 - 'Synthèse des analyses' (religion and ethnic group by département and commune)
subnational_sources.evidence: Fallback if the 2013 thematic volume does not go below département.

tier_reason: A census count of religion and ethnicity exists by département (12 = admin1) in INStaD's RGPH-4 PDFs, and by commune (77 = admin2 exactly) only through registered IPUMS microdata; no public CSV/XLSX is known to me.
recommended_action: Crawl instad.bj (and the legacy insae-bj.org) for the RGPH-4 synthesis/thematic PDFs and read the religion and ethnicity tables for the 12 départements with probe_pdf.py; this replaces the Afrobarometer R9 survey now on 9 of 12 admin1 rows (owner review). Note the boundary file spells 'Atlanique' where INStaD writes 'Atlantique' - add an alias. For the 77 communes, IPUMS 2013 is the route. Check whether RGPH-5 has been fielded before building.

summary: Benin's INStaD (instad.bj, formerly INSAE) asked religion and ethnic group in the 2013 RGPH-4 and publishes both by the 12 départements (= admin1) as PDF; the 77 communes (= admin2 exactly) are reachable through IPUMS-International's 2013 sample with registration. A census read would replace the Afrobarometer survey estimates currently on admin1. Tier B; watch for RGPH-5 and fix the 'Atlanique' spelling in the boundary file.
